title: Biologic DMARD for rheumatoid arthritis (e.g., adalimumab)
note: Synthetic, simplified policy for research use. Modeled on common criteria patterns; not any real insurer's policy and not clinical guidance.

criteria.text: Patient has a diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis.
Patient is 18 years of age or older.
Patient has tried methotrexate for at least 90 days.
Inadequate response to, or intolerance of, methotrexate is documented.
A negative tuberculosis screening test is on file within the last 12 months.
